use flux_hir::{lower_text, Diagnostic};
use flux_ty::{check_file, check_main, infer_body, signatures};
mod cases;

fn main() {
    for &(name, source, accepts, main_accepts) in cases::CASES {
        let (db, _, hir) = lower_text("input.rs", source);
        assert!(db.syntax_errors().is_empty());
        assert!(hir.diagnostics.is_empty());
        let (sigs, signature_errors) = signatures(&hir.items);
        assert!(signature_errors.is_empty());
        let typed = check_file(&hir);
        let main_error = check_main(&hir.items, &typed.sigs);
        assert_eq!(main_error.is_none(), main_accepts);
        assert_eq!(typed.diagnostics.is_empty() && main_error.is_none(), accepts);
        println!("case {name} accepts={accepts}");
        // Observe signatures and inferred binding types through public APIs.
        for (id, function) in hir.items.functions.iter() {
            if !hir.is_program(id) || function.ctor.is_some() { continue; }
            let sig = &typed.sigs[id];
            let params: Vec<String> = sig.params.iter().map(|ty| ty.to_string()).collect();
            println!("signature {}({}) -> {}", function.name, params.join(", "), sig.ret);
            if function.name.as_str() == "target" && name == "integer" {
                assert_eq!(params, vec!["u32"]);
                assert_eq!(sig.ret.to_string(), "u32");
            }
            if let Some((body, source_map)) = hir.body(id) {
                let inferred = infer_body(&hir.items, &sigs, id, body, source_map);
                let whole = &typed.bodies[id];
                assert_eq!(inferred.diagnostics.len(), whole.diagnostics.len());
                for (binding, data) in body.bindings.iter() {
                    let ty = whole.binding_types[binding];
                    assert_eq!(ty, inferred.binding_types[binding]);
                    println!("binding {}: {}", data.name, ty);
                    if name == "generic" && data.name.as_str() == "number" { assert_eq!(ty.to_string(), "u16"); }
                    if name == "generic" && data.name.as_str() == "flag" { assert_eq!(ty.to_string(), "bool"); }
                }
            }
        }
        let mut diagnostics = typed.diagnostics.clone();
        diagnostics.extend(main_error);
        Diagnostic::sort(&mut diagnostics);
        for diagnostic in diagnostics { println!("diagnostic {} {:?}", diagnostic.message, diagnostic.range); }
    }
}
